```{r}
# Create the data frame with proper column names and prevent automatic renaming
community_table <- data.frame(
  "Community" = c("Mpox Analytics", 
                  "IPSN - COP WES",
                   "Epidemiological Parameters", 
                   "Epidemiological Pipelines",
                  "AI for Disease Modeling"),
  
  "Users" = c(121, 101, 95, 70, 61),
  "Topics" = c(20, 36, 24, 47, 6),
  "Posts" = c(31, 123, 120, 155, 23),
  "Likes" = c(53, 156, 174, 126, 44),
  
  check.names = FALSE  # Prevents automatic conversion of spaces to dots
)

# Format the table to match the styling of metrics_table
community_table %>%
  kbl(
    format = "html",
    align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling( 
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
    full_width = FALSE,

    position = "center"

  column_spec(1, width = "20em", bold = TRUE) %>%   # Long community names
  column_spec(2, width = "8em") %>% # Total Users
  column_spec(3, width = "8em") %>%                # Topics
  column_spec(4, width = "8em") %>%                # Posts
  column_spec(5, width = "8em") %>%                # Likes
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#019ADE")  # Consistent header

```


# Cross-Community Connectivity {#cross-com}

The following table only considers membership in CoPs:

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| include: false

# Get all users first
all_users <- data1 %>%
  filter(!(email %in% c("discobot_email", "no_email"))) %>%
  mutate(UserID = row_number()) %>%
  select(UserID, email)

# Calculate cross-community connectivity for CoPs only
user_cop_memberships <- data1 %>%
  filter(!(email %in% c("discobot_email", "no_email"))) %>%
  mutate(UserID = row_number()) %>%
  separate_rows(group_names, sep = ";") %>%
  filter(group_names != "", group_names %in% df_cop$Tags) %>%
  select(UserID, email, group_names)

# Count number of CoPs per user (including 0 for users not in any CoP)
user_cop_counts <- user_cop_memberships %>%
  group_by(UserID, email) %>%
  summarise(num_cops = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Add users with 0 CoP memberships
all_users_with_counts <- all_users %>%
  left_join(user_cop_counts, by = c("UserID", "email")) %>%
  mutate(num_cops = replace_na(num_cops, 0))

# Create connectivity summary with proper ordering
connectivity_summary <- all_users_with_counts %>%
  mutate(
    membership_category = case_when(
      num_cops == 0 ~ "0 CoP memberships",
      num_cops == 1 ~ "1 CoP membership",
      num_cops == 2 ~ "2 CoP memberships",
      num_cops == 3 ~ "3 CoP memberships",
      num_cops >= 4 ~ "4+ CoP memberships"
    ),
    order = case_when(
      num_cops == 0 ~ 1,
      num_cops == 1 ~ 2,
      num_cops == 2 ~ 3,
      num_cops == 3 ~ 4,
      num_cops >= 4 ~ 5
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(membership_category, order) %>%
  summarise(
    `Number of Users` = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(order) %>%
  mutate(
    `Percentage of Total Users` = paste0(round(100 * `Number of Users` / sum(`Number of Users`), 1), "%")
  ) %>%
  select(
    `Membership Pattern` = membership_category,
    `Number of Users`,
    `Percentage of Total Users`
  )

```

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false

# Display cross-community connectivity table
connectivity_summary %>%
  kbl(
    format = "html",
    align = c("l", "r", "r"),
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    font_size = 15,
    position = "center"
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "19em", bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "12em") %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "21em") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#019ADE")
```

# Cross-Community Map

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)

# ---- Prepare and filter user data ----
data1_groups <- data1 %>%
  filter(!(email %in% c("discobot_email", "no_email"))) %>%
  mutate(id = row_number()) %>%               # create unique ID
  select(id, group_names) %>%
  separate_rows(group_names, sep = ";") %>%
  filter(group_names %in% df_cop$Tags) %>%   # only keep CoP tags
  distinct(id, group_names)

# ---- Compute shared membership edges ----
group_pairs <- data1_groups %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    group_pairings = if(length(unique(group_names)) >= 2) {
      list(combn(sort(unique(group_names)), 2, simplify = FALSE))
    } else {
      list(NULL)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest(group_pairings) %>%
  filter(!is.null(group_pairings)) %>%
  mutate(
    from = map_chr(group_pairings, 1),
    to = map_chr(group_pairings, 2)
  ) %>%
  count(from, to, name = "shared_members")

# ---- Compute node sizes ----
node_sizes <- df_cop %>%
  select(Tags, Members) %>%
  rename(name = Tags, member_count = Members)

# ---- Build graph ----
community_graph <- tbl_graph(edges = group_pairs, directed = FALSE) %>%
  activate(nodes) %>%
  left_join(node_sizes, by = "name") %>%                          # bring in member counts
  left_join(df_cop %>% select(Tags, Name), by = c("name" = "Tags")) %>%  # bring in display names
  mutate(
    member_count = replace_na(member_count, 1),
    display_name = Name
  )

# ---- Plot graph ----
ggraph(community_graph, layout = "fr") + 
  geom_edge_link(aes(edge_width = shared_members), alpha = 0.4, color = "#019ADE") + 
  geom_node_point(aes(size = member_count), alpha = 0.9, color = "#F09F33") + 
  geom_node_text(aes(label = display_name), repel = TRUE, size = 4, color = "#051D4F", face = "bold") + 
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 10)) + 
  scale_edge_width_continuous(name = "Shared Members") +   #fixes the label
  theme_void() + 
  labs(
    size = "Group Size", 
    title = ""
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, family = "Lato", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, face = "italic", family = "Lato", color = "#051D4F"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )


```
